_comment: Country-level economic indicators. `source_code` is the code in the source (World Bank WDI). `unit`: usd (published in USD millions), usd_pc (USD per person), people, pct. `group`: how a group's value is formed from its members (as of each year): sum = add members' values (only when members with data hold >= 95% of the group's population), none = not computed for groups. Derived indicators are computed at publish time from others. `hidden` indicators are inputs only.

indicators.name: GDP
indicators.description: Gross domestic product, current US dollars

indicators.name: GDP, constant prices
indicators.description: Gross domestic product, constant 2015 US dollars (used for real growth)

indicators.name: GDP per capita
indicators.description: GDP divided by population, current US dollars

indicators.name: Real GDP growth
indicators.description: Annual change in GDP at constant prices

indicators.name: Unemployment
indicators.description: Unemployment, % of labour force (ILO modelled estimate)

indicators.name: FDI inflows
indicators.description: Foreign direct investment, net inflows, current US dollars

indicators.name: Current account balance
indicators.description: Current account balance, current US dollars

indicators.name: Trade in goods & services, % of GDP
indicators.description: Exports plus imports of goods and services as a share of GDP (national accounts)
